verdicts.question: Is the building currently under construction?

verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?
verdicts.designer_notes: No designer answer for this target — the vision routine verifies it by tracing cables across photos with 'Cable Routing', 'Equipment Location', 'Meter Box' and similar captions on pages 4+.
verdicts.photo_observation: Only the AC input/output run (purple, 4C x 10 sq.mm x 2 sets) is drawn: meter-area MCB box (page 8 top) -> along wall -> inverter room (page 7). AC earthing (green) exits behind the door to the AC earth pit (pages 8-9). No PV array, DC cable, DCDB, solar meter, DC earth pit or LA routing is shown anywhere, and there are no roof photos despite a 20 kWp hybrid system (all roof Q1-10 answered N/A). Link between the meter-area run (page 8) and the inverter-room run (page 7) is not shown in a single continuous view.
verdicts.rationale: AC side is plausibly traced, but the DC/PV side of the run is entirely missing — cannot confirm end-to-end continuity. Clarify where the 20 kWp array is installed.
